headline: Conditional arrival-day trail run in California
summary: Garmin's latest completed sleep remains the pre-flight Sydney sleep: 7h 11m, score 80, sleeping heart rate 64 bpm, overnight HRV 42 ms, Body Battery 80 on waking, and Training Readiness 75. These values predate the long-haul flight and do not measure current flight fatigue. If alert, steady, hydrated, and symptom-free after arrival, run 10 km easy on the hilly trail at RPE 2–3, hike steep climbs, control descents, and cap the outing at about 75 minutes.

recovery.label: Sleep
recovery.context: Latest completed Garmin sleep was the pre-flight Sydney sleep. UTC window: 19 September 11:41–19:02, equivalent to 04:41–12:02 PDT; Garmin labels it 20 September in the still-Sydney source timezone.

recovery.label: Sleeping HR
recovery.context: 0.7 bpm below the prior 7-night average (64.7) and 0.9 bpm below the prior 14-night average (64.9). This was measured before the flight.

recovery.label: Resting HR
recovery.context: 2 bpm below Garmin's seven-day average of 59 bpm, measured before departure.

recovery.label: HRV
recovery.context: Garmin classifies HRV as balanced, but the overnight value predates the flight.

recovery.label: Stress
recovery.context: These are incomplete source-day measures collected before or during travel and are not a reliable summary of California arrival-day stress.

recovery.label: Body Battery
recovery.context: Garmin recorded a 60-point gain across the pre-flight sleep window; current post-flight charge may differ.

recovery.label: Training Readiness
recovery.context: Garmin reported 1 minute of recovery time after the pre-flight sleep. Do not let this score override sleepiness, dizziness, dehydration, unsteadiness, pain, or illness after the flight.

recovery.label: Recent load
recovery.context: Garmin classifies the load ratio as optimal. No make-up mileage is needed during travel.

yesterday.title: Date-line transition before California arrival
yesterday.summary: The prior California calendar day occurred while Nelson was still in Sydney or in transit, so the former Sydney weekday prescription cannot be compared directly. Garmin recorded no activity in the 19 September PDT interval.
yesterday.prescribed: No directly comparable California-day prescription existed for 19 September; the temporary travel plan begins with the conditional arrival-day run on Sunday 20 September PDT.
yesterday.completed: No activity was recorded between 19 September 00:00 and 23:59 PDT.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: Adherence cannot be assessed because the timezone transition changes the calendar-day mapping and the old Sydney schedule must not be applied day-for-day.
adherence_evidence: The post-refresh Garmin snapshot contains no activity with a UTC start between 19 September 07:00 and 20 September 07:00.
Nelson departed Sydney on 20 September local time and arrived in California on 20 September local time, crossing the date line.
adherence_caveats: Unrecorded activity cannot be assessed from Garmin.
Garmin's source timezone remains Australia/Sydney, so local labels are not reliable for California-day assignment during travel.

recommendation.title: Conditional 10 km easy hilly trail run after arrival
details: Only if alert, steady, hydrated, and free of concerning symptoms: run 10 km easy at RPE 2–3 and cap total time at about 75 minutes.
Hike steep climbs, keep the effort conversational, and control descents; do not add strides, tempo work, intervals, fast finishing, or make-up mileage.
Treat the first 10–15 minutes as an assessment. Flight fatigue and coordination matter more than the pre-flight Garmin readiness score.
recommendation.alternative: Reduce to 5–7 km easy, switch to daylight walking, or take full rest if markedly sleepy, dizzy, dehydrated, unsteady, ill, or experiencing posterior-tibial pain.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for posterior-tibial pain, altered gait, dizziness, unsteadiness, unusual sleepiness, dehydration symptoms, illness, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Medical advice and current symptoms override Garmin scores.

signals.label: Pre-flight recovery
signals.interpretation: The recorded night was reassuring but occurred before the long-haul flight, so it cannot clear the run by itself.

signals.label: Autonomic baseline
signals.value: Sleeping HR 64 vs 64.7 · HRV 42 vs 42 ms
signals.interpretation: Pre-flight heart-rate and HRV measures were near or better than baseline.

signals.label: Travel constraint
signals.interpretation: Post-flight alertness, hydration, balance, and symptoms determine whether the conditional run is appropriate; no make-up training is required.

caveats: Garmin's source timezone remains Australia/Sydney; UTC timestamps were used to reconcile the California-local date.
The latest completed sleep and readiness data predate the flight and may overstate current recovery.
Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load measures are wearable-derived; current symptoms and medical advice take priority.
No sensor source was identified for a run because no prior-day run was recorded.
